turns.user_utterance: My latest payment was declined, I was told everything was back to working order. What happened?
turns.assistant_response:
I’m sorry about that—if a card payment was declined even after things were said to be back to normal, it’s usually due to one of a few issues (like temporary merchant/bank authorization problems, card being used in a way that needs verification, or insufficient available balance). 

Can you tell me whether the decline happened in the last 24 hours, and what type of merchant/payment it was (online or in-store)?
